finiteCheck: GLSL isnan/isinf guard on final output, shading normal, pigment and authored slope; alpha sentinel counted on CPU
provenance: Generated graph shaders patched into actual Three r140/r187 physical chunks, each engine using its own WebGL2 WebGLProgram assembler. Generated color values, analytic height differentials and explicit mip-filtered float-image values/derivatives also sampled against the CPU interpreter. Native GLES3 validation, not browser rendering.
limitations: Native Mesa software driver, not browser WebGL. Static geometry only; does not measure interactive browser frame rate or animation.

independent.label: An independent anisotropic finish overridden across coat and bump

shared-image.label: The same atlas remains live for pigment and height

shared-branch.label: A mixed branch still consumes the shared module finish
